clips.title: The story
paras: Along Durotar's roads south of Orgrimmar, Rezlak waits for help with his supply lines. The goblin entrepreneur belongs to the Tinkers' Union and hires travelers to recover missing supplies and drive off harpies.

Rezlak waits beside the canyon road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. He represents the Tinkers' Union, a goblin syndicate focused on engineering, supply lines, and practical business. The factional tensions of Kalimdor matter little to him while trade runs smoothly. Dustwind harpies have raided his cargo caravans and made the routes unsafe. Rezlak remains at his post and hires passersby willing to earn a profit by recovering supplies and dealing with the harpies.
